visual.description: Full-viewport hero with oversized brand name spanning left two-thirds, a centered 3D aircraft image overlapping the full width, navigation bar fixed top-right, and a two-button CTA row anchored bottom-right with a tagline bottom-left.

Large display text occupies roughly the right 60% of the viewport, with the left 40% empty; below the text a 2-column feature grid (Flexible Solutions, Smart Quotes, Fully Customizable, Personalization) uses hairline top-borders as dividers with no card backgrounds.

Three equal-width full-height columns: dark navy left column with headline and CTA button, center column filled entirely by a photographic image, right column filled by a terracotta/rust color with a dashed-arc flight-path graphic and an aircraft icon.

Left half holds a single large rounded-corner photograph; right half contains a 2×2 grid of destination entries (city name in bold + IATA code, country below a hairline separator) with no card backgrounds.

Full-width dark panel split exactly 50/50: left half shows a hand holding a phone with the Hyer app ticket UI, right half is empty dark space with a small body-copy paragraph anchored to the bottom-right quadrant.

Oversized 'Experience' headline bleeds across full width; below it a 3-column layout where the left column holds a brand statement and CTA, and the remaining two-thirds is a 2×2 icon-card grid with dashed-border square icons and feature titles.

Continuation of the experience section showing the lower two icon cards (Service Add-ons, Personal Flight Manager) in the right two-thirds, with an empty left column except for a 'Contact us' pill button anchored bottom-left.
Single full-width edge-to-edge aircraft interior photograph with a slide counter (1/6) and left/right arrow controls overlaid at bottom-right.
White section with a small gray eyebrow label centered, followed by a massive display headline 'Book a flight' centered below it, set against a light gradient background.

Dark footer with the Hyer wordmark top-left spanning roughly one-quarter width, then three navigation columns (On-demand, Aircraft Ownership, Memberships) filling the remaining three-quarters, with social icon circles stacked below the logo.

Bottom footer strip split roughly 30/70: left column holds copyright, address, and chamber-of-commerce registration; right column contains a dense legal disclaimer paragraph alongside cookie/terms/privacy links in a 3-column sub-row.
